citations.quote: Illustrative scenario: Section 232 derivative pump and valve parts move to the 50% tier

Summary. For this exercise, assume a new proclamation reclassifies certain derivative steel and iron articles from Annex I-B (25% of full customs value) to Annex I-A (50% of full customs value). The change applies to goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse, on or after 12:01 a.m. EST on December 1, 2026.
8413.91 Parts of pumps for liquids 25% 50% 8481.30 Check (nonreturn) valves 25% 50% 8481.80 Other taps, cocks, valves 25% 50% 8483.30 Bearing housings; plain shaft bearings 25% 50%

Basis. Duty is assessed on the full customs value of the article, regardless of metal content. Only one Section 232 metals duty applies per article; duties do not stack across steel, aluminum and copper.
